exposure: Abnormal placentation (placenta praevia or morbidly adherent placenta)
cohort: 139 patients with abnormal placentation identified from a hospital database over a 2-year period (2015-2016)
finding: The study found that intraoperative cell salvage (IOCS) was associated with a reduction or elimination of allogeneic transfusion in a proportion of patients with abnormal placentation, a high-risk group for haemorrhage.
